text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what to do, what to do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot a rather worried-looking Mejiro Palmer with Daitaku Helios at a cafe in town.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Trainer! Helios and I were just thinking of having some tea.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What a coinkydink that you're here too! Time to bring the party to this cafe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for sure, but like…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, they've got this dessert buffet special going on right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: See? They've got a sign with huge letters saying, "Eat to your heart's content!" and everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But that "to your heart's content" part has got me shook. There's an angel and a devil duking it out in my head right now…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Who's gonna win?! I mean, that mountain of crepes looks bussin'! That angel's in for a tough one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "In for a tough one"? Nah, girl, she's already down for the count!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! I just wanna chow down on desserts!
choice_data_list: Let us be beguiled by the devil's persuasion together…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! I just wanna chow down on desserts!
choice_data_list: Let us be beguiled by the devil's persuasion together…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she can't give up! I can't let a sugar rush tempt me, not now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, bye-bye dessert buffet and hello regular menu.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wow, talk about willpower of steel! You know what, I'll join you in solidarity! Buffet's all yours, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I might not be able to indulge in it myself, but seeing you dig in to the yummy sweetness'll be good enough!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Eat enough for my bestie and me too! Avenge that devil!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't know how things turned out this way, but I end up filling up on dessert while Mejiro Palmer manages to restrain herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, for real?! I mean, I'm not planning to be in devil mode for the rest of my life or anything, buuut…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: YOLO! Time to give in to temptation for a day! Better flag down the waiter! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait! The waiter's gonna actually come over!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Welp… No stoppin' this train now! Let's live it up today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we let the devil literally sweet-talk us and gorge ourselves on desserts…
